t: The Chunk Controller is a crafting ingredient for the Chunky Turtle.$(p)Combine with a turtle or advanced turtle to make it chunk-loading!$(p)For the full documentation please see the $(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/items/chunk_controller/)official wiki page$(/l)$()!
区块加载器是制作厚重海龟的合成材料。$(p)将其与普通海龟或高级海龟合成，即可获得具备区块加载功能的海龟！$(p)完整说明请参阅$(9)$(l:https://docs.advanced-peripherals.de/items/chunk_controller/)官方维基页面$(/l)$()！
